create_dpmsolver_multistep_scheduler: create a DPMSolverMultistepScheduler instance with configurable solver order, beta schedule, and algorithm type for diffusion model inference
set_timesteps_dpmsolver: set the discrete timesteps and noise schedule for a DPMSolverMultistepScheduler before running diffusion inference
step_dpmsolver_multistep: predict the sample from the previous timestep by reversing the SDE using the multistep DPMSolver
convert_model_output_dpmsolver: convert the diffusion model output to the format needed by DPMSolver or DPMSolver++ algorithms
add_noise_dpmsolver: add noise to original samples according to the DPMSolver noise schedule at specified timesteps
